say:2:1120751001:1.text: We caught three terrabirds for you.
say:2:1120751001:1.source_cn: 三只陆行鸟都领回来了。

say:3:1120751002:1.text: Terrabirds are curious but easily distracted animals. They're sensitive to sound and vibrations in the ground, so you have to tread lightly. If you move too quickly, you've already lost.
say:3:1120751002:1.source_cn: 陆行鸟是好奇心强但集中力弱的动物，它们对声音和土地的震...

say:4:1120751003:1.text: A trainer named Rhys in the Claws taught me that.
say:4:1120751003:1.source_cn: 流沙之爪的驯兽师，诡草大哥，之前是这么告诉我的。

say:5:1120751004:1.text: Let me take a look... Not bad! Not bad at all! They've all got strong, sturdy legs! Their eyes are bright and healthy!
say:5:1120751004:1.source_cn: 俺瞅瞅……不错！不错！体态匀称，腿脚很有力道！眸子也闪...

say:6:1120751005:1.text: You really know what you're doing!

choice_prompt:7:1120751005.text: You really know what you're doing!

say:8:1120751006:1.text: With your supervision and with these mounts given to the clan, I think these two are redeemable. Trust can be gained.
say:8:1120751006:1.male: With your supervision and with these mounts given to the clan, I think these two are redeemable. Trust can be gained.
say:8:1120751006:1.female: With your supervision and with these mounts given to the clan, I think these two are redeemable. Trust can be gained.

choice:7:1:2.text: What's your opinion on the Claws now?
